train: 8526 original train examples except every reserved localization worker; gold intent/BIO only during training
development: 1504 previously consumed dev examples, no reserved workers; adaptive engineering, not fresh audit
reservation: Original test and every reserved worker remain unused until all development gates justify freezing a candidate
algorithm: Same quantized averaged perceptron and greedy decoder as sequence v5; lossless CSR storage with new module tag/codec. No legacy reinterpretation. Same 196608-byte page and 262144-byte full-genome/residency caps; more retained learned weights, not a raised memory limit.
change_hypothesis: Sparse row storage removes per-weight repeated keys/hex overhead; preserve exact scores at equal weights, then test whether less pruning improves acquisition and generalization. First two policies are same-weight controls.
selection: Exact complete dev structures, then fewer retained nonzero weights, then policy order
metrics: Exact intent and every ordered role/value; novelty strata, errors and abstentions always counted. No excluded weak families.
completion_contract: evals/protocols/m1-completion-v1.json; every gate unchanged and required before M1 or M2
scope: Known CSR representation and empirical supervised learner, not novel AGI or autonomous evolutionary generations. Public corpus teaches label meanings. Unknown process RSS/energy are unavailable. No effect execution or LLM teacher.
